name: Soft Depth
reference_prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Product: MacMCP, an open-source native macOS utility that lets AI agents reliably see and control desktop apps through accessibility references, verified actions, and an SSH relay. Asset type: standalone macOS app icon concept, square high-resolution composition. Create one carefully resolved original mark, not a sheet of options. Strong silhouette at small sizes, generous internal spacing, restrained color treatment suited to a professional Mac developer tool. The icon may have a softly rounded square tile, with truly transparent pixels outside its silhouette. Face-on orthographic artwork, crisp deliberate geometry, subtle material depth only if useful; no photorealistic objects, no scene, no surrounding labels, no typography, no badges, no Apple logo, no watermarks. Primary request: A bold, memorable pointer arrow carefully nested within an open desktop window frame, so the negative space communicates precise targeting and dependable control. The arrow and frame should feel integrated into one balanced symbol, with broad simple forms rather than many tiny controls. Avoid bullseye rings, crosshairs, robot faces, and decorative AI sparkles. Make this polished enough to sit in the macOS Dock.
final_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, the selected MacMCP framed-cursor app icon. Create one refined version of this same icon, not a different concept and not a contact sheet. Preserve the identity: the rounded-square deep-blue tile, the pale desktop window frame with an open lower edge, the three red/yellow/green window controls, and the large diagonal white pointer integrated with the lower edge. Preserve the cool blue family and the calm professional Mac utility character. Square, front-on composition. No letters, no words, no badge, no extra symbols. Keep genuine transparency outside the rounded-square tile and clean alpha edges, without disconnected specks or glow extending beyond the silhouette. Change only materials and lighting. Keep essentially the same layout and scale, but replace the bright neon and hard rim glints with soft porcelain-like white surfaces and quiet broad studio lighting. The frame and pointer should have shallow, elegant sculpted depth, while the tile feels matte deep blue with a very restrained gradient. Reduce the purple saturation of the highlights. No metallic chrome, no glass transparency, no strong glow. A calm, premium, tactile native macOS icon.

wordmark.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: a single horizontal product logo lockup for MacMCP, an open-source macOS desktop control tool for AI agents. Input image 1 is a reference for the icon's identity, not a background to keep. Make a matching clean brand lockup: simplify the reference's desktop-window frame and pointer into a crisp, flat emblem, retain its open lower edge and recognizable pointer silhouette, and pair it with the exact wordmark "MacMCP". Spell the text exactly M-a-c-M-C-P, with no spaces or extra words, carefully typeset in a refined contemporary sans-serif, medium-to-semibold weight, balanced kerning. The emblem and wordmark should have balanced optical size and comfortable separation. Wide horizontal composition with generous breathing room, all logo content fully visible. Truly transparent canvas, no colored background plate, no mockup, no caption, no tagline, no watermark, no effects outside the logo, no scene. This is a flat logo suitable for a README or website header, not another glossy app tile. Preserve the reference's identity while removing the outer square tile and reducing glossy shading to simple solid color. Variant for LIGHT backgrounds: dark graphite wordmark, emblem in a solid deep blue drawn from the reference. Ensure the type is dark and highly legible on white.

wordmark_dark.generator: scripts/wordmark-dark.swift from the light wordmark (off-white lettering, emblem blue lightened 35%)
